title: Brand system overview — video poster

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use a familiar outline to organize different human moments so variety remains identifiable.
strategic_value: The nested rounded frames can connect personal imagery with Instagram’s recognizable shape.
demonstration: The supplied Vimeo poster layers portraits and everyday scenes inside nested rounded-square openings. The overview video is unavailable.
practical_value: Compare how a recognizable mask can hold varied photographs without needing a separate frame around each.

content_islands.name: Nested image frames
content_islands.spec: Fill the landscape field with successive rounded-square photo crops.

content_islands.name: Central moment
content_islands.spec: Keep the smallest everyday scene at the center as the sequence’s visual destination.

reference_purposes.Expression: The poster combines human imagery with nested rounded-square masks.
